verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted project-management service and its CLI or tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The cited items cover only views, fields, workflows, the API, and probes for an MCP server and CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
